title: Nebula Runtime API v1 frames
description: JSON Lines request, response, and event frames for the authenticated local runtime control plane.

launch_agent_kind.description: Agent kinds with an officially verified interactive cold-start command.

name.description: The server additionally enforces a 256-byte UTF-8 limit. Empty restores the generated title.

screen.description: Include the live screen v1 color grid, independently of the text tail and desktop scrollback offset.

screen_viewport.description: Opt in to the controlled desktop viewport, including scrollback. Requires screen=true and the pane.read.screen.viewport.v1 feature. Text tail semantics are unchanged.

screen_history.description: Independent bounded history page; requires screen=true, no screen_viewport, and pane.read.screen.history.v1. Null/omitted start follows the tail. Coordinates survive ordinary append/eviction; column reflow changes physical rows.

argv.description: Direct program argv; no shell expansion is performed. The server enforces a 32768-byte aggregate limit.

git_params.description: Git runs on the explicitly selected computer pane. The server rechecks its current cwd, resolves the repository root and checks the supplied status revision before a write. Read-only mobile channels allow status, diff and history only. Requests have a 25-second total execution deadline and a 256-KiB stdout limit.

expected_cwd.description: Exact cwd from the pane snapshot; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

path.description: Exact repository-relative change path, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Never interpreted as a shell command or glob.

staged.description: Select the index diff rather than the worktree diff.

all.description: Stage or unstage all changes in the repository, including when the pane cwd is a subdirectory.

revision.description: Opaque revision returned by git.status. Required for mutations; an outdated revision produces git_stale before execution.

message.description: Commit message, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Only staged changes are committed.

commit.description: A full object ID selects the commit diff instead of a current change.

offset.description: History offset; each response returns at most 50 commits and has_more.

tab_id.description: Ephemeral identity, preserved by reorder and split. Absent on older runtimes.

state_change_seq.description: Monotonic per-pane counter, bumped every time task_state changes. Capture it before sending work, then pass it as wait's after_seq so an unchanged pane cannot satisfy the wait.

path.description: Absolute path on the computer; only in-app readable files are accepted.

wrapped.description: Optional soft-wrap flag per physical row, preserving logical lines during phone-only reflow.

history.description: Absolute physical row range [oldest,end); first is the returned page start. Alternate screen or mouse tracking sets application_scroll and returns the live grid, not normal history.

terminal_screen_v1.description: At most 40000 cells and 128 KiB UTF-8 glyphs; each glyph <=256 UTF-8 bytes. Row widths must equal columns. Color <0 references -(palette index+1); otherwise RGB. Flags: bold=1, italic=2, underline=4, strike=8, dim=16, hidden=32. Cursor is [x,y,visible]. Oversized grids return screen_too_large, never a silently cropped frame.

lines.description: Positive scrolls up; uses the native terminal wheel routing without activating the window.
